digest.component_or_area: metrics adapter: GitHub Actions coverage & CI-health harvest
propositions: Coverage percentage and CI-health metadata (status, duration, red-to-green recovery, flake rate) must be harvested from GitHub Actions run history and persisted as labeled snapshots to the git-tracked metrics store
GHA adapter is isolated and optional; core metrics modules and future _commands/metrics.py must not import it to maintain portability
Harvester script reads GHA run logs and metadata via API after CI completion and writes snapshots to .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson, not to CI workflow or gitignored reports/ directory
Coverage is extracted via anchored word-boundary grep of the pytest-cov TOTAL line in run-log tail; red-to-green recovery interval computed from fail-to-pass run pairs
Unit tests validate adapter coverage parsing against fixture logs, red-to-green duration calculation, and core module isolation via import scanning
